_comment: Building-facade art-direction overhaul (2026-09-03, see next steps.md §7.15 and unreal/apply_building_material.py): replaces M_BuildingFacade's flat horizontal-stripe placeholder (frac(V)<0.5 window-band hack) with real CC0 PBR wall/roof texture sets, blended per-building via vertex color and overlaid with an in-shader window grid. CC0 PBR sets from ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com) - the whole site is published CC0 1.0 (public domain, no attribution required; see https://ambientcg.com/about). All zips fetched at 2K-PNG resolution via ambientCG's public download API (https://ambientcg.com/get?file=<AssetId>_2K-PNG.zip), no login required. Same convention as content_src/textures/ground/ and content_src/textures/road/ (download script + manifest.json ARE committed, extracted binaries are NOT - see repo .gitignore).

textures.notes: Red brick wall variant 1 - main street storefront/rowhouse facade look.
Tan/buff brick wall variant 2 - distinct enough from Bricks074 to read as a different building at a glance.
Horizontal wood siding - mountain-town residential/cabin-style facade.

Plain concrete/precast wall - larger City-archetype buildings. Same asset_id content_src/textures/road/Concrete034 already uses for road shoulders; fetched again here as its own copy so the building material's import script doesn't reach across domain dirs.
Shingle roof - applied to top-facing (roof) triangles via vertex-normal Z mask.
